68be2b1755144754ce8835d0_description: Hey Mercenary, I have a task for you. There is mysterious person who thinks a lot like I do that entered the Tarkov Region. I have agreed to help him make a name for himself. We all know we need more people who think like I do around here. I promised him some goods and I need you to scout out the area and then leave the items I have for him. He is planning to pick up the supplies somewhere on Ground Zero.
68be2b1755144754ce8835d0_started: Please don't let me down. We need to make this person feel at home in Tarkov. If you succeed, I will introduce you to him.
68be2b1755144754ce8835d0_success: Great work Mercenary! This mysterious person is ready to meet you. I will let him do the formal introduction.
68be2b1755144754ce8835d0_accept: Please don't let me down. We need to make this person feel at home in Tarkov. If you succeed, I will introduce you to him.
68c1d84c6ad813879c6e4610: Visit the doorway at the top of the staircase at Nakatani Basement.
68f3fceb709d8cc5468bcb7d: Leave the Mysterious Backpack near the blocked staircase at Nakatani Basement.
